verdict.rationale: Maritime runs each agent, including coding agents like Claude Code and Codex, in its own cloud micro-VM with secrets injected only into that VM. It also offers per-end-user Linux desktops that agents can drive. Together these let AI-driven code run on Maritime's infrastructure rather than yours. However, the docs never frame this as a sandbox for untrusted code or describe its isolation or security guarantees. missing for 10: an explicit untrusted-code sandbox or execution API, documented isolation boundaries (network egress limits, resource limits, VM hardening), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation.
